dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are visible on the upper dorsal ridge, featuring sharp outer light-toned perimeters that transition into darker interior gradients. The perimeters are irregular and jagged, with high-contrast boundaries against the dark fur.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, solid light-colored pixel clusters distributed primarily across the mid-lateral and posterior regions. These clusters appear as point-like features with high local intensity and lack internal texture or gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most dorsal macro-annuli form an obtuse, scalene triangle. A separate cluster of four high-intensity blobs near the neck region forms a compact, irregular quadrilateral.

other_distinctive_markers: A fine, reticulated network of high-contrast light lines connects several larger annuli along the lateral flank, creating a interconnected web-like visual pattern.
